n_hook.text: Calls like this are rarely caught. Compliance teams can manually audit only one or two percent of collection calls.

n_rules.text: R B I's rules are clear. Identify yourself and the lender. Call only from eight A M to seven P M. No threats, abuse or shaming. Never tell anyone else about the debt. And offer a grievance channel.

n_title.text: Vaani Audit checks every call, in Hindi, Telugu and code-mixed speech, with Gnani's Prisma speech-to-text and Timbre voices.

d_intro.text: This is a real run on the live Gnani A P I. First, a synthetic Hindi call, made at eight fifteen P M.

d_run.text: Gnani Prisma transcribes both sides of the call, agent and borrower, and timestamps every turn.

d_result.text: Each violation comes with the exact quote, and the second it happened. Click it, and you hear the evidence.

d_coach.text: For coaching, Timbre speaks the compliant way to say it, in the same language.

d_telugu.text: The same works in Telugu. Listen to this agent and a farmer.

d_telugu_res.text: He called the farmer a liar, threatened to seize his tractor, and gave no grievance channel. All flagged, with evidence.

d_team.text: Managers see compliance by agent, the top violation types, and a coaching card for every agent.

n_arch.text: Under the hood: Prisma v3 Batch transcribes each leg of the call, with domain keywords and a topic. Deterministic R B I rules produce every finding, with a timestamp and a verbatim quote. An optional L L M may only add a finding whose quote is really in the transcript.

n_results.text: On 12 held-out calls never used for tuning, F1 is point 94 with Prisma v3 and keywords, and point 92 at zero decibels. The weak spot is the rules: new ways of shaming were caught only half the time.

n_close.text: Every call audited, with evidence. Built solo by Yarra Vivek, on Gnani AI.
